about.label: About
about.title: Building useful tools
about.paragraph1: Marseille-based developer with an unconventional path - social worker, then artisan, then business owner, now developer. What I kept from each step is the same instinct: building tools that genuinely save time for the people who use them.
about.paragraph2: I design and build web applications focused on the Shopify ecosystem : public apps, custom Liquid themes, Checkout Extensibility migrations. Certified Shopify Partner.
about.paragraph3: Alongside this, I'm developing a mobile inventory management SaaS with barcode scanning, originally designed for cosmetic labs. Vertical-specific presets are in the works for construction trades and food artisans (bakers, butchers, restaurateurs).
about.paragraph4: On the creative side, I work with Illustrator, Figma, and Photoshop. This allows me to deliver mockups, visual identities, and vector assets without relying on an external designer.
about.currentlyContent: 2 Shopify apps being finalized for the App Store, Android beta of the SaaS being stabilized, Liquid themes delivered to direct clients.

ritualize.title: Ritualize AI
ritualize.description: Shopify app turning product discovery into personalized recommendations via an intelligent diagnostic engine. Three-tier SaaS monetization with strict feature gating, real-time analytics, and Klaviyo lead sync.
bullets: Diagnostic engine with complex conditional logic

stockr.title: Stockr
stockr.description: Inventory management SaaS designed for non-digitized small businesses. Offline-first mobile experience for field operations, desktop interface for management, business presets for friction-free onboarding.
bullets: Smart Seeding by industry vertical (construction, food artisans, cosmetics)

reality-essential.title: Reality Essential
reality-essential.description: Custom Shopify theme built for Laboratoire Maraterra, a French B2B cosmetic manufacturer. Conversion-focused interface for a professional audience, with qualifying multi-persona form and dedicated service sections.
bullets: Custom sections for services and expertise pillars
Premium Clean Beauty design with animated client gallery
ISO 22716 compliance and EU regulatory standards integrated

portfolio.title: by-dvr
portfolio.description: Bilingual personal portfolio built with Next.js 16, featuring dynamic locale routing, Framer Motion animations, and a custom design system. Designed as both a technical demonstration and a showcase.
bullets: App Router architecture with dynamic [locale] segment and Server Components
Full server-side i18n system with next-intl
Dark-first design system with Tailwind 4 tokens
Scroll and entry animations respecting prefers-reduced-motion
